prompt_md: A loan's interest rate rises from 4% to 5% a year. By what percent did the interest rate itself go up?
prompt_short: Interest rate rises from 4% to 5%. Percent increase in the rate?
explain_intuition_md: The rate went up by 1 percentage point, but that point is a quarter of the old 4%. So you now pay 25% more interest than before.
